title: 第13章 炖山鸡第14章 小吉 天麻
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第13章炖山鸡
据江有林自己说，他是碰见一只黑熊，被追的滚下山，摔伤了腿……但他也射中了黑熊一只眼。
当然，村中大多数人就当后半句是吹牛。
连江尘和江田也是半信半疑。
“爷爷，你看二叔抓的山鸡！”
江晓芸主动开口。
“不错。”
江有林微微颔首：“不过打猎可不是靠运气就成的，别太得意了。”
“明白。”
江尘目光紧紧盯着江有林背后的牛角弓：“嫂子，挑一只最肥的炖了，给爹补补身子。”
江有林刚严肃起来的脸瞬间蚌埠住了，嘴角不断想要上扬，又被一次次强行按下去。
“德性。”
骂了一句，江有林拄拐走进堂屋，背对着江尘嘴角彻底上扬。
虽然觉得江尘哄着自己，肯定是为了背后吃饭的家伙，可也不妨碍他高兴。
陈巧翠俯身从四只山鸡里挑了最肥的一只，开始拔毛处理。
另外三只，江田从外面铲了些积雪盖在上面保鲜。
一只留着吃，剩下两只拿去卖。
晚饭依旧是粟米粥，外加一锅炖山鸡。
还有陈巧翠说的那种黑色植物根茎——苦根，是冬日少有能挖到的野菜。
炖山鸡刚端上桌时，一股香气就扑鼻而来。

比昨天的炖兔肉香多了，汤面上还飘着一层黄色的油花。
这次不止江能文，江尘也忍不住吞了吞口水。
“吃吧吃吧。”
江有林笑着开口。
江能文立刻举起碗，等着江田帮忙盛。
江尘先尝了一口鸡汤，顿时鲜得舌头发软——这可比炖兔子好吃多了。
“好鲜！
这怎么做的？”
“就多撒了点盐，没别的。”
陈巧翠也尝了一口，不在意说道。
难怪。
content_en:
Chapter 13 Stewed Pheasant
According to Jiang Youlin himself, he encountered a black bear and was chased down the mountain, injuring his leg...but he also shot the black bear in one eye.
Of course, most people in the village took the latter part as a boast.
Even Jiang Chen and Jiang Tian were dubious.
"Grandpa, look at the pheasant that my second uncle caught!"
Jiang Xiaoyun took the initiative to speak.
"Not bad."
Jiang Youlin nodded slightly: "But hunting doesn't rely on luck, so don't be too proud."
"Understood."
Jiang Chen stared closely at the ox-horn bow behind Jiang Youlin: "Sister-in-law, pick the fattest one and stew it to replenish your father's health."
Jiang Youlin's serious face instantly froze, and the corners of his mouth kept trying to raise, but were forced down again and again.
"Virtue."
After cursing, Jiang Youlin walked into the main room on a crutch, with his back turned to Jiang Chen and the corners of his mouth raised completely.
Although he felt that Jiang Chen was coaxing him for the sake of the guy behind his back, it didn't stop him from being happy.
Chen Qiaocui leaned over and picked the fattest one from the four pheasants and began to pluck it.
For the other three, Eda shoveled some snow from outside and covered them to keep them fresh.
Keep one to eat, and sell the remaining two.
Dinner is still corn porridge, plus a pot of stewed pheasant.
There is also the black plant rhizome that Chen Qiaocui mentioned - bitter root, which is a rare wild vegetable that can be dug in winter.
When the stewed pheasant is brought to the table, a scent hits your nostrils.
It's much more fragrant than yesterday's stewed rabbit, and there's a layer of yellow oil floating on the soup surface.
This time not only Jiang Nengwen, but also Jiang Chen couldn't help but swallow his saliva.
"Eat, eat."
Jiang Youlin smiled and spoke.
Jiang Nengwen immediately raised the bowl and waited for Jiang Tian to help fill it.
Jiang Chen took a sip of the chicken soup first, and his tongue was immediately softened by the freshness - it was much more delicious than stewed rabbit.
“So fresh!
How is this done? "
"Just a little more salt, that's all."
Chen Qiaocui also took a taste and said casually.
No wonder.
